title: Computational Analysis of Albaflavenone Interaction with SlMAPK1 for Drought Resistance in Tomato.
authors: Alfagham, Alanoud T; Debnath, Sandip; Perveen, Kahkashan; Paul, Amitava; Alsayed, Mashail Fahad; Khanam, Mehrun Nisha
one_liner_zh: 该研究用分子对接和MD模拟分析微生物代谢物Albaflavenone与番茄蛋白SlMAPK1的结合，属于蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA体系，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: As global agricultural challenges intensify, particularly drought stress, the exploration of innovative strategies for crop resilience has become crucial. This study focuses on the role of the microbial endophyte metabolite Albaflavenone in enhancing drought resistance in tomato (Solanum lycopersicum L.) through the activation of the SlMAPK1 protein in the MAPK pathway. To computationally analyze the interaction between Albaflavenone and SlMAPK1 and to elucidate the potential enhancement of drought tolerance in tomato plants through this interaction. We utilized molecular docking, homology modeling, and molecular dynamics simulations to investigate the binding affinities and interaction dynamics between SlMAPK1 and Albaflavenone. Functional network analysis was employed to examine protein-protein interactions within the MAPK pathway, while the MM-GBSA method was used to calculate binding free energies. Our computational analyses revealed that Albaflavenone exhibited a high binding affinity to SlMAPK1 with a binding energy of - 8.9 kcal/mol. Molecular dynamics simulations showed this interaction significantly stabilized SlMAPK1, suggesting enhanced activity. Specifically, the root mean square deviation (RMSD) of the Albaflavenone-SlMAPK1 complex stabilized at around 3.1 A, while the root mean square fluctuations (RMSF) indicated consistent amino acid conformations. Additionally, the radius of gyration (R(g)) analysis demonstrated minimal variance, suggesting a compact and stable protein-ligand complex. The significant binding affinity between Albaflavenone and SlMAPK1 highlights the potential of leveraging plant-microbe interactions in developing sustainable agricultural practices. These findings also demonstrate the effectiveness of computational methods in dissecting complex biological interactions, contributing to a deeper understanding of plant resilience strategies against environmental stresses.
abstract_zh: 随着全球农业挑战的加剧，尤其是干旱胁迫，探索作物抗逆性的创新策略变得至关重要。本研究聚焦于微生物内生菌代谢物Albaflavenone通过激活MAPK通路中的SlMAPK1蛋白，在增强番茄（Solanum lycopersicum L.）抗旱性中的作用。为计算分析Albaflavenone与SlMAPK1之间的相互作用，并阐明这种相互作用对番茄植株抗旱性的潜在增强机制，我们采用了分子对接、同源建模和分子动力学模拟来研究SlMAPK1与Albaflavenone之间的结合亲和力及相互作用动态。功能网络分析用于检查MAPK通路内的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用，而MM-GBSA方法则用于计算结合自由能。我们的计算分析显示，Albaflavenone对SlMAPK1表现出高结合亲和力，结合能为-8.9 kcal/mol。分子动力学模拟表明，这种相互作用显著稳定了SlMAPK1，提示其活性增强。具体而言，Albaflavenone-SlMAPK1复合物的均方根偏差（RMSD）稳定在约3.1 Å，而均方根波动（RMSF）则表明氨基酸构象一致。此外，回转半径（R(g)）分析显示方差极小，表明蛋白质-配体复合物紧凑且稳定。Albaflavenone与SlMAPK1之间的显著结合亲和力凸显了利用植物-微生物相互作用开发可持续农业实践的潜力。这些发现也证明了计算方法在解析复杂生物相互作用中的有效性，有助于更深入地理解植物应对环境胁迫的抗逆策略。
